messages:
maria-partners: Hey team — quick handoff: product wants a small set of modular Terraform samples for marketplace partners (AWS + GCP) that show a minimal 'deploy Redwood Private' refarch, packaging notes, and CI for publishing artifacts. Goal: make it easy for partners & SIs to onboard. Need owners for: module authoring, network/security review, CI & packaging, and marketplace checklist. Target: publish samples and run a partner demo in ~10 business days. Volunteers? :wave:

sophie-terraform: I'll take module authoring. I'll create a repo under partners/terraform-modconnectors and push a skeleton with modules/aws, modules/gcp, examples/quickstart. ETA ~5d. Will include variables.tf and outputs for endpoint, lb dns, and a minimal example usage.

ajay-arch: I can own the reference architecture diagram + network/security review. Two quick asks: do modules need public IP by default for agents, or should we default to VPC-only mode? Also we should include KMS/HSM integration notes and egress cost guidance. I'll draft CIDR/recommended SG rules.

kevin-cloud: I'll own packaging + marketplace checklist (AMI/ECR + GCR). Need the install scripts and a clear runtime matrix (supported instance types: e.g., g4dn/p4/A100 + arm64 Graviton guidance). Also will add marketplace publishing steps and required metadata.

maria-partners: Perfect. Sophie — include a minimal smoke test as part of the module examples: terraform apply -> call /health -> run a tiny generate request and validate response tokens <= threshold. Example test snippet we can standardize:

```bash
# smoke.sh (concept)
ENDPOINT=${ENDPOINT} \
API_KEY=${TEST_KEY} 
curl -s -X POST "$ENDPOINT/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}' | jq '.output[0].tokens'
```

Make smoke a gated job in CI so samples can't be merged without passing.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline created: partners-modconnector-samples — status: pending. URL: <https://ci.example.com/pipeline/partners-modconnector-samples> :gear:

sophie-terraform: Sounds good. For the smoke I'll add a small helper `smoke.sh` that accepts `--endpoint` and `--api-key` and asserts a 200 + token count < 50. Also will provide a mock/test-key flow for CI so we can run against a staging host. Example usage in README.

ajay-arch: Network mode proposals: 1) public (quickstart, NAT + public LB) 2) vpc-peered (preferred for enterprise) — for vpc-peered I'll document route tables, required VPC endpoints, and sample peering workflow. I'll also add a section on recommended firewall rules and example Security Group inbound/outbound.

kevin-cloud: Packaging notes: AWS -> AMI + ECR image + CloudFormation quickdeploy. GCP -> Container + Deployment Manager / terraform module. I'll add driver/kernel pinning notes (NVIDIA driver versions) and a tested instance matrix. CI will publish artifacts to partner staging accounts.

maria-partners: Timeline recap: demo to partner in 10 business days. Action items: Sophie (modules + smoke + README), Ajay (refarch + network/security doc), Kevin (packaging + marketplace checklist). I'll schedule partner demo and collect compliance/legal asks. Add blockers here.

sophie-terraform: Logging/telemetry: we'll include an optional telemetry sink config (CloudWatch/Datadog) that is disabled by default. We'll make it explicit in examples how to opt-in.

ajay-arch: I'll run image scans (trivy) and add a CI gate for critical/high vulnerabilities. Also will include KMS instructions for secrets (do not hardcode API keys).

kevin-cloud: A couple more items: (1) confirm support for multi-arch images (amd64 + arm64) for partners using Graviton (2) include sizing guidance for concurrency + expected latency for common instance types so partners have realistic expectations.

maria-partners: Quick legal/branding Q — do we need legal sign-off to include partner logos in README and sample dashboards? tagging legal separately.

sophie-terraform: I'll add an MIT-compatible license stub and a note that co-branding requires legal approval.

maria-partners: deploy-bot — any CI feedback?

deploy-bot: partners-modconnector-samples: build pipeline started -> jobs: fmt ✅, lint ✅, unit-tests ✅, smoke-test ⏳. Link: <https://ci.example.com/pipeline/partners-modconnector-samples/2876543210> :rocket:

maria-partners: Great. If smoke passes, we'll merge and cut a release branch for partners. Reconfirming owners: Sophie (author), Ajay (security/arch), Kevin (packaging/marketplace), Maria (partner coordination). We'll do a sync in 3 days or sooner if blockers. :calendar:
